meta.name: verify-ui-change
meta.description: Check that a change to a web app actually works in the running app before calling it done. Drives the real page and returns a pass/fail verdict with the request that fired, the state that moved, and the file:line to fix. Use after editing a component, a form, a route, or an API call; when you have said "fixed" but have not opened the app; when the user asks "does it actually work?"; or when a change looks right on screen and you cannot prove it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 改完网页代码后驱动真实页面跑一遍,直接给出通过与失败结论。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面却没法证明它真的能跑通。
copy.tagline_en: Drive the real page after a web change and get a clear pass or fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page and can't prove it actually works.

howto.what: 改动网页应用后，Claude 会在真实运行的页面里跑一遍，给出通过或失败的结论，并附上触发的请求、变化的状态，以及需要修改的 file:line。
howto.when: 改完组件、表单、路由等之后，或你已说「修好了」却没打开应用时，它会接管验证。

say.text: 验证一下这次改动在运行的应用里到底能不能用。
say.note: 驱动真实页面，返回通过/失败结论。

say.text: 我改了登录表单，跑一遍确认提交后确实调了接口。
say.note: 报告发出的请求和状态码。

say.text: 这改动看着没问题，帮我证明它真的生效了。
say.note: 给结论；失败时附上 file:line。

howto.what_en: After you change a web app, Claude drives the real running page and returns a pass/fail verdict, with the request that fired, the state that moved, and the file:line to fix.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you edit a component, form, route, or API call; when you say "fixed" without opening the app; or when the user asks "does it actually work?"

say_en.text: Verify whether this change actually works in the running app.
say_en.note: Drives the real page and returns a pass/fail verdict.

say_en.text: I changed the login form - run it and confirm the submit really calls the API.
say_en.note: Reports the request that fired and its status.

say_en.text: This change looks fine on screen; prove it actually took effect.
say_en.note: Gives a verdict plus the file:line on failure.
